svg.title: Жим штанги в Смите сидя — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. SEATED SMITH-MACHINE SHOULDER PRESS, front 3/4 view. Both figures SIT on the same visible weight bench with backrest/horizontal seat/legs, feet on ground, between TWO tall vertical Smith-machine guide rails. ONE long barbell with plates at both ends, its ends visibly connected to rail sliders. Left bar at chin/upper chest, elbows bent below it. Right bar above head, arms extended. Bar travels vertically along guide rails. Do not show free dumbbells or standing posture. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
